warnings: The two cantilever details referenced from the B9 section on sheet 5 ('ดูแบบขยายแผ่นที่ 2/6'). This sheet resolves what sheet 5 leaves illegible: B9 is 0.25 x 0.40 with 2 + 2 Ø25 top (two separate labels, both anchored ≥ 1.50 m into the column / the continuing B3) and 2-Ø25 bottom (≥ 1.00 m). Sheet 5's B9 entry keeps its own reading (top count null) — same mark, two section sources, no contradiction.

B3 here is only the end-of-span bar arrangement at the column where B3 continues into B9 (3 straight top, 3 straight bottom, two bent-up sets of 3-Ø25 at 2.50 / 2.00 from the column centre); its section size is on sheet 5 (0.30 x 0.80) and is not repeated here.
The หมายเหตุ text block under the two building sections is in _view5_notes.json.
